audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 read Skill, but the entry's own spikes[0] tells you to 'eat the early chip' and never CS inside his auto range, and whys[0] has you last-hitting at max Q range without trading. That is a losing stage, not an even one. Every stage from Level 3 on was already correct.
audit.why: Lane difficulty is a key point; Teemo genuinely owns level 1 here and the chart hid it.
audit.corrected: Level 1 set to Teemo; the rest of the chart left as-is.
sources: the entry's own spikes[0] and whys[0]

audit.whatIsWrong: Blinding Dart is named as the matchup-defining cooldown in both layers and its duration is never given.
audit.why: Power spikes and windows are a key point, and the entry's whole plan is 'bait the dart, then commit' — which needs the number.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart quoted as 7s flat at every rank, Miasma as 24s. 7s flat matters here specifically because it never gets shorter, so the window does not shrink as the game goes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two strings — spikes[2] and mid — tell you to use Petrifying Gaze to 'stun him as he tries to run'. Riot's own text on the ability stuns only enemies in front of Cassiopeia who are FACING her, and slows any others with their back turned. A fleeing Teemo has his back turned, so the ultimate you saved for the kill gives you a slow.
audit.why: Point 4 is the most important point, and this is the exact case the facing rule punishes: the entire matchup is chasing a champion whose plan is to run away from you.
audit.corrected: Gaze stated as stunning only targets facing you; the sequence corrected to cut him off with Miasma first and stun him as he turns, not as he flees. The mirror audits/top/teemo__cassiopeia.json independently added the same facing rule from Teemo's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Toxic Shot is described only as poke; nothing says it is on-hit magic damage that scales with his attack speed.
audit.why: It changes the defensive item entirely — a Cassiopeia who buys armour into a Teemo has read the trade backwards.
audit.corrected: On-hit magic scaling stated in wants.foe[1] with MR as the answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Twin Fangs' appears in spikes[1], spikes[2], wants.you[0], wants.you[1], mid and whys[2].
audit.why: Riot's name is Twin Fang; the mirror found the same pluralisation error.
audit.corrected: Renamed in every string I edited.

edits.before: Two points across Q and E plus Miasma on his retreat line online — your first window to chain Twin Fangs on a poisoned Teemo and out-grind the blind's value.
edits.after: Two points across Q and E plus Miasma on his retreat line online — your first window to chain Twin Fang on a poisoned Teemo and out-grind the blind's value.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze stuns him as he kites, Miasma slows-and-poisons to pin his move-speed escape, and refunded Twin Fangs delete a Teemo who can't outrun you.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze only stuns targets facing you — a fleeing Teemo just gets slowed, so pin him with Miasma first, then Gaze him as he turns and Twin Fang.

edits.before: Bait Blinding Dart on a fake step-up, then drop Miasma on his kite path and chain Twin Fangs on the poison while the dart is down
edits.after: Bait Blinding Dart on a fake step-up, then Miasma his kite path and chain Twin Fang on the poison through its 7s downtime

edits.before: Reach level 3 so refunded Twin Fangs on a Q/W-poisoned Teemo out-grind his blind-and-burst poke
edits.after: Reach level 3 so a refunded Twin Fang on a Q/W-poisoned Teemo out-grinds his blind-and-burst poke

edits.before: Stack Toxic Shot and dart poke, then zone the wave and brush chokes with Noxious Trap shrooms
edits.after: Stack Toxic Shot's on-hit magic damage with attack speed — armour reads this trade wrong, so buy MR

edits.before: The full Noxious Blast into Twin Fang chain plus Miasma on his retreat line comes online — the cloud's slow pins his kite and Twin Fangs refund their cost on a poisoned Teemo.
edits.after: The full Noxious Blast into Twin Fang chain plus Miasma on his retreat line comes online — the cloud's slow pins his kite and each Twin Fang refunds its cost on a poisoned Teemo.

edits.before: From level 3 this becomes your lane: prime with Noxious Blast, lay Miasma across his retreat path so the cloud slows and poisons his move-speed escape, and chain Twin Fangs that refund their cost on a poisoned target. Teemo has no dash or blink, so once Miasma's slow pins him he simply can't kite out of your range — and Blinding Dart only blanks one auto, never your Q/W poison or the Twin Fang spam feeding off it. At 6, Petrifying Gaze turns a won trade into a kill: stun him as he tries to run, hold him in Miasma, and shred.
edits.after: From level 3 this becomes your lane: prime with Noxious Blast, lay Miasma across his retreat path so the cloud slows and poisons his escape, and chain Twin Fang casts that refund their cost on a poisoned target. Teemo has no dash or blink, so once Miasma's slow pins him he cannot kite out — and Blinding Dart, 7s at every rank, only blanks one auto, never your poison or the Twin Fang spam feeding off it. At 6 remember Gaze stuns only a Teemo facing you: cut him off, then stun as he turns.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Blinds your autos — trade with spells while it is up. Check it before every step-up. - W Miasma is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — 7s flat, and it blinds autos only; your poison and Twin Fang fire straight through it. - W Miasma is the lifeline at 24s. - Gaze stuns only a Teemo who is facing you.
